reason: A client-only DSH Web plugin for customizing the interface background, surface transparency, image fitting, and persistent background preferences.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供鲸鱼壁纸、背景图片自定义、透明度和铺放方式设置，并持久化保存用户偏好。
summaries.en: A client-only DSH Web plugin that customizes the background image, surface transparency, image fitting mode, and persistent display preferences.

capabilities: customizes the DSH Web background and translucent surface appearance
accepts local image data or remote image URLs for backgrounds
stores background preferences in browser localStorage
